command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step: create opsadmin user =="
sudo -n adduser -D -s /bin/ash opsadmin
sudo -n passwd -l opsadmin

echo "== step: install ssh key =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /home/opsadmin/.ssh
echo 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid' | sudo -n tee /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys > /dev/null
sudo -n chmod 700 /home/opsadmin/.ssh
sudo -n chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
sudo -n chown -R opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh

echo "== step: harden sshd_config for key-only auth =="
sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.bak.$(date +%s)
sudo -n sed -i \
  -e 's/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' \
  -e 's/^#\?KbdInteractiveAuthentication.*/KbdInteractiveAuthentication no/' \
  -e 's/^#\?PubkeyAuthentication.*/PubkeyAuthentication yes/' \
  -e 's/^#\?PermitEmptyPasswords.*/PermitEmptyPasswords no/' \
  -e 's/^#\?ChallengeResponseAuthentication.*/ChallengeResponseAuthentication no/' \
  /etc/ssh/sshd_config
grep -q '^UsePAM' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sudo -n sed -i 's/^#\?UsePAM.*/UsePAM no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'UsePAM no' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config > /dev/null

echo "== step: validate config =="
sudo -n sshd -t

echo "== step: restart sshd =="
sudo -n rc-service sshd restart
sudo -n rc-service sshd status

echo "== verify: effective config =="
sudo -n sshd -T | grep -Ei '^(passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|pubkeyauthentication|permitemptypasswords|usepam)\b'

echo "== verify: authorized_keys =="
sudo -n cat /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys

echo "== verify: opsadmin locked (no password login) =="
sudo -n getent shadow opsadmin | cut -d: -f1,2
